pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding consecutive volume (no grid or averaging down) into an active drawdown; pyramiding is only authorized after existing positions have hit breakeven plus a +$5.00 trailing buffer.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility cap and volume profile imbalance check; entry is blocked if price action is within 10 pips of an unmitigated high-impact liquidity wick or if the calculated stop-loss exceeds $5.00.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger partial profit locks at +$10.00 and full trailing stops at +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric win capture between $15.00 and $30.00.
